run_ttyrec_record_terminal: run ttyrec.py to record terminal session output to a .ttyrec file for later playback
run_ttyrec_execute_command: run ttyrec.py with --execute to record the output of a specific shell command
run_ttyrec_append_mode: run ttyrec.py with --append to append new terminal recordings to an existing file
run_ttyrec_no_input: run ttyrec.py with --no_input to save recordings in legacy ttyrec format without input data
run_ttyrec_custom_dimensions: run ttyrec.py with --rows and --columns to override terminal dimensions in the recording
